# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Confirmed the branch already contains the approved molt/mineral fixes, so this apply-fixes pass was validation-only and required no source edits. I rechecked the named molt parameter wiring, high-mineral diagnostics, and ideal reproduction harness coverage, then reran the focused regressions plus the full `tank_core` suite; all passed on the current branch, including the previously noted `thermal_reproduction_penalty` and `root_zone_oxygenation` coverage.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current branch for the approved shrimp molt/mineral parameter, event-diagnostic, and harness changes to verify the review-approved fixes were still present before making any edits.
2. [Completed] Reran focused regressions for molt/mineral behavior, current-schema stage-timer save/load handling, and the controlled ideal reproduction harness path.
3. [Completed] Ran the full `tank_core` suite to confirm broader stability and recorded this stage as validation-only because no further code changes were needed.

## Validation Evidence

- `rg -n "molt_reserve_fraction|critical_molt_gh_ratio|HighMinerals|controlled_ideal_reproduction_path_still_hatches" crates/tank_core crates/tank_harness crates/tank_scenarios`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load current_schema_roundtrip_preserves_zero_stage_timer_for_newly_added_adults -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_harness controlled_ideal_reproduction_path_still_hatches -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture`

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
